verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs say Word, Excel and PowerPoint files convert without Office or LibreOffice. They explicitly document Excel/OpenDocument/CSV sheets going to PDF with Excel-like page fitting or into each other, plus DOCX → HWPX. However, Word→PDF, PowerPoint→PDF, and Word/PowerPoint conversion between office formats (e.g., DOCX↔ODT, PPTX↔ODP) are only implied by a generic 'convert' claim, so coverage of the full story is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Word and PowerPoint to PDF, explicit Word/PowerPoint inter-office-format routes (DOCX/ODT/RTF, PPTX/ODP), fidelity details for these conversions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: Word, Excel and PowerPoint files convert without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice
Excel, OpenDocument and CSV/TSV sheets, to PDF with Excel-like page fitting or into each other, without Excel.
DOCX → HWPX keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures
presets can merge everything into one PDF or one ZIP
